Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE EMPTY room composition candidate for a 2D winter cabin companion game. Input image is STYLE reference ONLY; its rejected all-in-one furniture layout must NOT be copied. Match its fine handpainted illustration, worn brown vertical timber boards, exposed beams, muted brown plank floor, simple practical furnishings. Smooth illustration, NOT pixel art. Make ONE landscape 16:9 image at candidate size about 1672x941 or 1600x900, never 2560x1440. No borders, text, labels, UI, collage or people. Quiet compact room, sparse furnishings and LARGE furniture: enough space for a future adult standing figure with height 42-48% of entire frame, not a distant doll. Three-wall slightly elevated frontal perspective with broad usable floor, minimal ceiling. No expansive empty foreground. Room materials same as reference.
CRITICAL clean-plate state: neutral diffuse light, no fire, glow, orange sunlight, lamps, light fittings, candles, kettle, food, bowls, cups, coats, books lying open, curtains, plants, rugs, pictures, souvenirs or miscellaneous clutter. Fixed furniture only; listed opening repair equipment and 2-3 old closed manuals allowed. Windows show flat plain desaturated BLUE placeholders instead of a painted outdoor view, so pane masks can replace them. Glass BLUE ONLY, frame opaque. All image edges fully opaque. No transparency fades. Interior door opening dark neutral interior continuation, no glow baked; runtime adds firelight. Separate room, not a cutout of an all-in-one house.
